newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mixed.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices remained mixed on Monday in lackluster activity, dealers said.

"I think the (millfeed) markets almost nationwide are in a very even balance and people are waiting for something to knock them out of that balance, but it has not yet occurred," a St. Louis dealer said.
Another Minneapolis broker noted little demand for this week. "People are waiting till last minute," he said.

A Carolinas dealer agreed activity was subdued. "I have not seen anything traded," he said. "Values are high in the nearbys. (CBOT) corn and beans are still going down. Buyers are resisting to do anything and the sellers have sold all they can sell, production wise," a Carolinas dealer said.
In the Kansas/Oklahoma interior, cows were pasturing during the past few days as a result of mild weather, dealers said.
